title: Research programs.
bodyText: The director may initiate, conduct, and support research, demonstration projects, and investigation, as the department's resources may allow, and coordinate state agency research programs pertaining to hazardous waste management.
bodyHtml: [§342J-39]  Research programs.  The director may initiate, conduct, and support research, demonstration projects, and investigation, as the department's resources may allow, and coordinate state agency research programs pertaining to hazardous waste management. [L 1989, c 212, pt of §5]
